steady_rail_planning.derivation: For 0 to 50 C add 1% accuracy, 0.2% line, 0.5% load and 0.02%/K times 25 K. Add the full ripple allowance on either side: TMR3 50 mV, TMR1 110 mV. Steady planning only.

LDO.note: Conservative sum of separate DC parameters is a planning estimate. Small supervisor margin and transient behavior require measurement at the actual 30 mA maximum load. Output capacitor 100 uF is intentional and is not an MLCC DC-bias estimate.

limitations: The 4 A AUX allocation applies to the specified 350/60 mA per-channel loads, not simultaneous full rated loading of every output. The Pico 100 mA reserve is an engineering allocation dependent on firmware/GPIO; measure it.
The 4.5 V current calculation is conservative budgeting only. 4.5 V at the system connector is not a valid operational lower limit once fuse drop is included.
Module efficiency, idle current and startup timing have no complete guaranteed combined worst-case budget here. Measure eight-module startup, input sag and fuse coordination.
TMR maximum 5% step deviation can cause a nuisance undervoltage trip at worst DC corner. A fault must remain latched off; do not bypass the supervisor to hide rail sag.
Positive TMR3 output rating is 600 mA; negative TMR1 rating is 200 mA. No sharing is assumed. Thermals, ripple and transients remain bench acceptance checks.
ADC and isolator circuit completion must stay within the reserved loads or revise the budget.
